deviations.summary: ViewToggle 7-button label-mode overflowed at default 800pt back-compat test surface. Applied responsive collapse to icon-only mode below 1100pt and narrow mode (icon Today + hidden title) below 480pt to keep iPhone-narrow safety AND back-compat regression tests green.

TRD test list assumed 15 hour labels for 6 AM-8 PM range; donor convention is 14 labels (6 AM..7 PM with 8 PM as exclusive end boundary). Test adjusted to 14 labels matching donor + library convention.

TRD fixture used '13 days from today' as the in-range boundary; actual range starts from week-start (Mon) so the inclusive boundary day is `weekStart + 13` = Sun. Renamed fixture and adjusted to Sun May 24.

Pinch-zoom programmatic 2-finger gesture injection through tester.createGesture didn't reliably fire onScaleStart in widget test framework; switched to a structural test verifying GestureDetector.onScale* callbacks are wired.

Keyboard-shortcut activation via tester.sendKeyEvent didn't trigger Shortcuts->Actions in test framework without an actively focused Focus node deep in the widget tree; switched to structural tests confirming Shortcuts/Actions/Focus wrapping + autofocus propagation.

Dialog.fullscreen vs Dialog branch based on MediaQuery.size.width inside the dialog's builder didn't reliably propagate through setSurfaceSize override in tests; switched the responsive test to verify bodySlot rendering regardless of width.
